verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer guide lists its own call-handling features: User Call Handling, State-based Rules, Interaction Rules and Call Handling Configurations. These imply time/state-based routing rules, but the evidence is only navigation titles and never explicitly describes business hours, after-hours, or holiday behavior. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of business-hours schedules, closed/after-hours routing, holiday schedules, per-number (vs per-user) configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
